title: Her openings as the deck plans write them, on E, C, B, A and the Boat deck: R3, a sourced table for S1's WINDOWS (and G17)
written: 2026-11-20, by the R3 session (Claude Opus 5.5), on the coordinator's word of about 23:08 CST, under docs/research/RESEARCH_rooms_plans_licence_v1_1_2026-11-20.md
rules: Facts only: which room, where, how big, which door to which. No image or drawing of any plan is kept. Every row cites the reference read and the original checked, or says it was not checked. Bets are tagged as bets.
reference: ET: Encyclopedia Titanica's free deck plans of E, C, B, A and the Boat deck (https://www.encyclopedia-titanica.org/titanic-deckplans/; drawn by Bruce Beveridge for Titanic The Ship Magnificent, The History Press 2008), read on the page in the built-in browser on 2026-11-20, nothing saved
how: One row a group of like openings on one side of one room (or of the rooms it names): kind (sidelight, window, door in her side, gangway door, house door, deck light), where it stands (in her side, a house wall, the deck), the plan's own words, its size as printed (inches, in the printed order: a window's two figures multiply to its area whichever is its height), its count, the frames it spans, its side (P, S, P&S, front, aft wall, fwd wall), and the room or rooms of that deck's table it serves.

Counts: as printed ('N OFF') where the plan prints one; where the printed count is for both sides, half a side is a bet and says so. Where the plan prints no count, the openings were counted on the page: along her side by pixel profile (Utley's sidelights and the windows in her side are bars in her side's double line; round sidelights are rings on its outer line), checked by eye on a few stretches; elsewhere by eye. A count the plan does not let one make is null, with the reason.

Clear size: 'clear' is true where the plan writes the clear opening or clear glass, false where it writes the frame's size, null where it does not say. Heights above the deck: the plans give none, except the reading room's words on its windows' two levels.

Derived fields (x_m, zone by C.zoneAt, area_each_m2 and area_m2 from the size and count) are written by: node tools/rooms_table.js --write data/rooms/openings.json. tools/rooms_table_tests.js checks the rows, their sizes and counts, that each stands inside its deck and its rooms, and sums the counts and clear areas per deck and side.

E deck was added on the coordinator's optional pass (about 23:31): its sidelights and doors in her side from the stern to 83F counted, its bow's two stretches with their printed sizes and no count. Not tabled: the openings of D and the lower decks, and a count of E deck's bow (for a later pass); E deck's door-like swings at 14.5A (starboard), 36.5F (starboard) and 85.5F (both), not read as doors; the well decks' wash ports and freeing ports; B deck's galley windows and the 5' 3" x 2' 6" windows by its forward second-class entrance (not read with confidence); the Boat deck's 34" x 31" clear glass by the bridge.

frames.note: E deck's anchors (her frames, feet forward of amidships); each row's metres are taken through its own deck's table.
